transferable_lessons: For counting/currency questions, do not trust literal keyword matches like 'buy'/'purchase' in isolation -- verify the location context (shrine name, place name) matches the question before committing a clip_qa call to that time window, since generic shop/merchant scenes recur many times in a long gameplay video.

When a time-ranged run_sql query truncates long text fields, also query the companion object_states table (or select a longer substring) for the same window -- the specific numeric/status detail often lives in a structured field, not the free-text description.

Once a correct SQL hit for the target window is found, prioritize a clip_qa visual check on that exact window before broadening the time search further; do not let a later, more keyword-flashy scene override an already-found time-correct clue.

Treat DB caption numbers (especially large multi-digit OCR-style counters) as provisional; a direct clip_qa pixel read at the correct time window is more reliable than trusting the cached caption text verbatim.
